proposed_english: I am declaring (to you) / I am proclaiming them
rationale: Lycopolitan present-I declarative idiom of teacher-address. The verbal element (ⲛⲉⲓⲧ-/ⲛⲉⲓ̈ⲉⲧ-) is unclear in morphology but consistent in function. Possibly compound on ϫⲱ 'say' or ⲱϣ 'cry, proclaim.' Used in this kephalaion as a revelatory formula introducing the doctrine of the two substances.

From ⲧⲱϩ 'join, mix, match' substantivized. Functions as the technical correspondential identifier in formulas like ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲓ̈ ⲡⲧⲏϩ ⲁ-X 'this matches/corresponds to X.' Names the act of typological/correspondential identification by which one mystery is mapped onto another.

Action-noun formed with Lycopolitan nominalizing prefix ⲟ̄ⲓⲛ-/ⲟ̄ⲓ̈ⲙ̄- on ⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'shine, radiate' (same root as ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance' in glossary). Preserves active verbal-emission semantics: 'the shining-forth' as activity, not static brightness.

Companion action-noun on ϩⲱⲧⲡ̄ 'set (of sun, stars).' Pair-partner to ⲧⲉⲩⲟ̄ⲓⲙ̄ⲡⲣ̄ⲓⲉ in the day/night mystery framework — sunrise (shining-forth) and sunset (setting) as the two correspondential moments.

Lycopolitan compound place-noun, possibly ⲙⲁ-(ⲛ-)ⲧⲉⲟⲧⲉ 'place of stationing' from a stand/dwell verb. In context paired with ⲧⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛ 'storehouses' and ⲟⲁⲙ 'powers' as the loci/dwellings of the sons of darkness from which they emerge at the cosmogonic moment. Confidence moderate.
Restored from line 32 ⲛⲟⲩⲃⲏ[ⲃ]; appears with ⲛⲟⲩⲛ ('Deep') as the dark places left behind by the sons of darkness when they emerge against the First Man. Coptic ⲃⲏⲃ 'cavern, hollow.'

Qualitative of ⲧⲁⲗⲟ 'mount, be raised upon' (cf. ⲧⲁⲗⲏⲩ in glossary). Used here of the Five Sons (light-armor) mounted upon the body of the First Man as he descends — the standard Manichaean cosmogonic image of the warrior-investiture.

Reduplicated verb related to ϣⲣ̄ⲣ̄/ϣⲣϣⲣ̄ 'scatter, disperse, break.' In context (humans coming out at dawn to do their daily work upon the Cross of Light), expresses the scattering/disturbing of the Light-substance distributed in earthly matter. Cf. accumulated ⲭⲣⲁⲣⲁⲧ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'scattered forth.'
